newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA,conditions 14 january: santa fe - no vessels berthed, none in roads, none due. Max. recommended draft 29 ft. 8 ins. at access channel. Diamante - No vessels berthed, none in roads, none due. Max. recommended draft 29 ft. ins. at passage KM 520. San Lorenzo - Three vessels berthed of which 1 discharging methanol, 2 loading wheat. 4 Vessels in roads, 17 due at 9 terminals during the forthcoming week. Max. recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. High tide, vessels up to 22 metres beam 3,200 ft/fw (high tide), vessels over 22 metres beam 3,106 ft/fw (high tide). Forecast indicates that draft will not vary over the next week.

Pasa berth draft 24 ft. 01 ins. fw. Rosario - Three vessels berthed which 1 awaiting orders, 1 loading wheat, 1 discharging steel products. 2 Vessels in roads, 3 due within the next week. Max. recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Forecast indicates that draft will not vary over the next week. Villa Constitucion - No vessels berthed, none in roads, 2 due. Elevator berths - Max. draft 22 ft. 0 ins. fw. Max recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. San Nicolas - Four vessels berthed of which 2 discharging iron ore, 1 loading pig iron, 1 loading coils. No vessels in roads, 7 due within the next week. Max. recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. San Pedro - No vessels berthed, none in roads, 2 due. Recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel.

Buenos Aires - 16 Vessels in port, 27 due within the next week. Max. recommended draft 31 ft. 6 ins. fw. high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Buenos Aires dock sud - Max. recommended draft 29 ft. fw. high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Necochea - Three vessels berthed all loading wheat. 2 Vessels in roads, 8 due within the next week. Depth at zero at the access channel 37 ft. 04 ins. BW. - Max. recommended sailing draft high tide 40 ft. 0 ins. BW. with special permission of coast guard. Bahia Blanca - Four vessels berthed of which 2 loading wheat, 1 sun pellets, 1 discharging heavy goods. No vessels in roads, 18 due within the next week. Draft varies from berth to berth.

BRAZIL, Jan 14 - Vitoria - Five vessels berthed of which 3 general cargo, 1 bulk wheat discharger, 1 pig-iron discharger. Tubarao - 2 Iron ore loaders. Praia Mole - 3 Steel products loaders, 2 bulk coal dischargers. Portocel - 1 Cellulose loader. Ubu - No vessels, 8 waiting in roads. Rio de Janeiro - 14 Vessels berthed of which 2 general cargo/container dischargers, 5 general cargo dischargers, 2 wheat dischargers, 1 oil discharger, 1 garlic discharger, 2 steel products loaders, 1 caustic soda discharger. Tecon - 3 Vessels, 27 due over the next 7 days. Santos - 21 Vessels berthed of which 1 bulk oil discharger, 1 bulk chemical products discharger, 5 full containers, 5 general cargo, 3 bulk fertiliser dischargers, 1 bulk cement discharger, 2 bagged sugar loaders, 3 bulk wheat dischargers. No vessels waiting in roads, 75 due over the next 7 days.

Private terminals - Cosipa - 1 Iron ore discharger, 2 steel products loaders, 1 bulk coal discharger. Ultrafertil - No vessels. Sao Sebastiao - Tebar - 2 Vessels berthed. Commercial quay - No vessels, 2 waiting in roads, 5 due over the next 7 days. Paranagua - Eight vessels berthed of which 1 bulk fertiliser discharger, 4 general cargo, 1 reefer loader, 2 pellets loaders. 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 1 to load general cargo, 4 to discharge (2 pellets, 1 reefer, 1 general cargo). 19 Vessels due over the next 7 days. Rio Grande - Four vessels berthed of which 1 bulk wheat discharger, 1 soya pellets loader, 1 full container loader, 1 soya oil loader. No vessels waiting in roads, 14 due over the next 10 days.

CHILE , Jan 13 - Arica - One vessel berthed and operating, 5 berths vacant. 8 Vessels due during the week. Iquique - One vessel berthed and operating, 5 berths vacant. 13 Vessels due during the week. Antofagasta - Four vessels berthed, 2 berths vacant. 7 Vessels due during the week for loading/discharging concentrates, bulk copper, containers and general cargo. 1 Vessel in roads awaiting cargo. Valparaiso - Six vessels berthed and operating, 1 berth vacant, 1 berth out of service for enlargement (Pier 3) until April 1997. 7 Vessels due during the week. San Antonio - Seven vessels in port operating, 2 berths vacant. 14 Vessels due during the week. Port busy but no waiting time.

Puerto Montt - One coaster berthed. No vessels waiting in roads, 2 due during the week. Punta Arenas - One vessel and 1 coaster berthed, 4 vessels due during the week. Conception Bay ports - Talcahuano - No vessels berthed, 3 due during the week, none in roads. San Vicente - Two vessels berthed and operating, 1 berth vacant. No vessels waiting in roads, 4 due during the week. Navy pier (Molo 500) - No vessels at terminal, 1 due during the week. Steel pier - No vessels at terminal. Coronel pier - No vessels at terminal. Oil terminal - No vessels at terminal, 3 due during the week. Lirquen - Three vessels berthed, 3 berths vacant. 3 Vessels due during the week. Penco - No vessels at terminal.

PERU, Jan 13 - No strikes at any port. Callao - Three vessels anchored, 8 general cargo/container vessels berthed, no berthing delays. Paita - No vessels anchored, 2 frozen cargo vessels berthed, no berthing delays. Bayovar, Pisco, Ilo - No vessels, no berthing delays. Talara - Four oil tankers anchored, no vessels berthed, no berthing delays. Chimbote - One fish meal vessel anchored, no vessels berthed, no berthing delays.

VENEZUELA, Jan 14 - All ports working normally. Puerto Ordaz - One vessel loading iron ore, 3 vessels due. Boca Grande - One vessel waiting at anchorage to load. Mile 178 - One vessel waiting at anchorage to load. Mile 60 - One passenger vessel. Matanzas - Two vessels waiting at anchorage to load/discharge. 6 Vessels operating, all loading, of which 4 steel products, 1 loading wire rods, 1 briquettes. 2 Vessels due. San Felix - One vessel loading steel products. Venalum - Two vessels operating of which 1 loading aluminium, 1 discharging pitch. 1 Vessel due. Alcasa - One vessel due. Puerto Cabello - One vessel waiting at anchorage to load. 10 Vessels loading/discharging general cargo, 15 due. Guanta - Three vessels operating of which 1 loading/discharging general cargo, 2 discharging (1 salt, 1 barytes), 5 due.

La Guaira - Three vessels loading/discharging general cargo, 1 passenger vessel, 6 due, 2 under repairs. Maracaibo - Four vessels loading/discharging general cargo. Puerto Miranda - Six vessels loading crude oil. El Tablazo - Two vessels loading urea. La Salina - Three vessels loading crude oil. San Francisco - One vessel loading crude oil. Buoy B.71, Palmarejo Sur, Punta Palma, San Lorenzo, Bajo Grande, La Ceiba - No vessels. Cardon - Four vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 6 loading refinery products. Amuay - Three vessels waiting at anchor to load, 4 loading refinery products.
